    morx_size     # length
)

print(f"Total font size: {len(font)}")  # 12 + 16 + 52 = 80

# When bsearch accesses element 0, it reads 6 bytes (static_size of LookupSegmentSingle<HBUINT16>)
# But only 4 are within the blob → 2 bytes past blob → MSAN uninitialized read

# Actually wait - I need to verify that the font size is correct.
# The blob IS the entire font. So bytes past offset 79 (last byte) are uninitialized heap.
# The segments bytesZ starts at: morx_offset(28) + 8(morx header) + 16(chain header) + 12(subtable header) + 2(format) + 10(binsearch header)
segments_bytesZ_offset = morx_offset + 8 + 16 + 12 + 2 + 10
print(f"Segments bytesZ starts at byte offset: {segments_bytesZ_offset}")  # 76
print(f"Segments data end (validated): {segments_bytesZ_offset + 4}")  # 80
print(f"Font size: {len(font)}")  # 80
print(f"Reading element 0 would access bytes {segments_bytesZ_offset} to {segments_bytesZ_offset + 5}")  # 76 to 81
print(f"Byte 80 and 81 are past the blob!")
